title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
summary: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.
